profile_description: Personalizes your analytics and error reports.
director_description: Optional. Screenforge works fully without an account.
director_signedOutBody: Sign in to a Director workspace to share videos as links, use your workspace's brand kit, and open Director recordings to edit.
director_waiting: Approve the sign-in in your browser.
director_waitingHint: Screenforge finishes signing in on its own once you approve. The link works for a few minutes.
director_signedInBody: Share links, the brand kit and Director recordings are on. Sign out at any time; your projects stay on this computer.
director_notRemembered: This computer has no keychain Screenforge can use, so you'll need to sign in again after quitting.
director_error_expired: The sign-in link expired. Try again.
director_error_failed: Couldn't sign in to Director. Check your connection and try again.
director_error_disconnected: This app was disconnected from Director. Sign in again to reconnect.
